summary: Unified Membership & Monetisasi module tested end-to-end. 27/27 backend pytest cases passed and all critical frontend flows verified (admin monetization tabs+stats, product prices, audit log, company registration -> free quota display -> upgrade-member -> pending, JobForm posting-mode-banner, mobile 390px overflow). Covers: (a) free quota 1/month with atomic consume, 2nd job 403, extra-field bypass rejected; (b) admin approve job sets expires_at=+7d; (c) company membership payment submit -> admin approve -> subscription active +90d; (d) member mode gives listing_days=30 and multiple posts allowed; (e) renewal EXTENDS existing sub by 90d (no duplicate active); (f) entitlement separation candidate<->company; (g) CV Profesional regression via unified endpoints (budi active 2026-09-13, new candidate 403 -> subscribe+approve -> POST /cvs 200); (h) admin monetization overview/payments filters/subscriptions filter/product edit+revert/payment-settings/audit-logs/extend/cancel; (i) security anon 401, candidate 403.

critical_code_review_comments: CvDocIn schema uses `name`/`template`/`data` while CV Profesional page/tests historically referenced `title`/`template_id` — schema is consistent internally but doc/comment could be clearer for future maintenance.

expire_subscriptions() is called on nearly every read (has_entitlement, get_company_entitlement, admin lists, cv status). Fine for current volume; consider a periodic background task if collections grow (>10k active).

consume_free_quota does upsert-then-atomic-update pattern; the upsert of quota doc is not fully idempotent under high concurrency (two concurrent inserts could conflict) — mitigated by unique index on (company_id, period_year, period_month) which exists at line 1760; behavior is safe.

get_active_subscription/has_entitlement uses expires_at string comparison ($gt now_iso()); works because ISO-8601 timestamps sort lexicographically for same timezone offset (all values written with datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()). Any future write with different tz format could break comparison.

membership_payment_info exposes payment_methods to any authenticated user (candidate + company) which is intended; note there's no product-specific filtering so both roles see the same list — acceptable per spec but may confuse UX.
admin_mon_reject uses CvRejectIn (legacy class name) — cosmetic; consider renaming to RejectIn or PaymentRejectIn.
